beats.care: Expect slow roads and flooded underpasses. Plan buffer time, keep your phone charged, and avoid low-lying streets after heavy spells.
beats.what: IMD says the northeast monsoon has set in over Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. On Tuesday it only said the monsoon could arrive soon.
beats.why: The southwest monsoon has fully withdrawn and winds have turned easterly. IMD forecast heavy rain for Chennai, Tiruvallur, Chengalpattu and Kancheepuram on Saturday.

cards.body: GCC listed 219 places that flood easily. Stormwater drains are done at 93 of them, and work is still going on at 19.

cards.body: Perungudi zone has more than 40 flood-prone spots. Sholinganallur, Anna Nagar and Tondiarpet each have over 20. If you live or work there, check the news before you head out.

cards.q: What does the monsoon 'setting in' mean here?
cards.why: IMD declares onset when the southwest monsoon has withdrawn and easterly winds start steady rain over the region.

hook: The monsoon is officially here. *What changed since Tuesday?*

learn.t: Chennai gets most of its yearly rain from the northeast monsoon between October and December, not from the June–September monsoon.
